Exoscale.summary_note: Exoscale is a top-tier choice for jurisdictional sovereignty. It is technically more 'sovereign' than IONOS because its parent company lacks a significant US carrier operation, essentially severing the CLOUD Act 'nexus.' It is also operationally cleaner than Arvato/Microsoft because it runs on its own code (CloudStack), not a US-licensed stack. However, the 'trace' remains: its majority shareholder is a non-EU telecom giant (América Móvil), and its hardware is US-origin. For 2026, it is the most practical 'Neutral Ground' (CH/EU mix) for highly sensitive data.
